messages:
Alex C.: Quick Q2 OKR milestone check-in — doing a compact pass across eng + product so we have a single list of what shipped, what slipped, and immediate owners/next steps. I'll list items, add owners and short status. Please react or reply with literal ETA or "blocked".

Alex C.: 1) Runtime v2 model routing: owner @Mateo R. — EXPECTED: canary this week. STATUS: slipped ~2 days due to quantization flakiness on A100. Ask: Mateo, ETA on fix/rollback path?

Mateo R.: working on it. quant tests failing when sequence length > 1024 on q4 profile. root cause is kernel precision divergence. ETA ~48h if no new regressions. leaning to rollback to q3 in canary to keep schedule. :thinking:

Priya K.: noting slip. Prioritize rollback if it stabilizes canary. We can't delay Dedicated customers' rollout. Can Mateo add the rollback toggle to the canary playbook?

Mateo R.: yes, adding rollback toggle now. snippet:
```
# canary playbook add
model_variant: q3-fallback
policy: canary(10%) -> rollback_on_error
```

Jin S.: ping on CRs for the routing changes — two approvals pending (me + Sara). Mateo — can you rebase? small conflicts with perf-test harness.

Mateo R.: rebased and pushed. @Jin S. assign if ok.

Sara L.: looking now. note: infra change required for prefix cache eviction policy — that'll be a separate rollout. I'll call out dependency in the rollout checklist.

Omar H.: FYI infra ETA for cache change: cluster upgrade starts tomorrow 02:00 UTC, estimated 6h. If that slips we'll need to decouple the cache policy from canary and roll it later.

Priya K.: OK — plan: proceed with canary using q3-fallback, track metric deltas, and gate prefix-cache dependent features until infra is green. @deploy-bot can you post canary once live?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime-v2-routing q3-fallback at 2026-05-18T10:00:00Z. Notifying #eng-runtime and #oncall. :loudspeaker:

Alex C.: Thanks all. Quick final asks: (a) Mateo — follow-up message here when tests pass or rollback executed. (b) Jin + Sara — quick CR review today if possible. (c) Omar — flag if infra slips. We'll compile a short status for execs after canary completes. :thumbsup:

Mateo R.: will update. If tests pass earlier I'll post immediate status.

Jin S.: will review by EOD PST.

Sara L.: adding checklist entry to the rollout doc and pinging QA for smoke.

Omar H.: will post infra runbook status in #eng-infra if anything changes.

Alex C.: cool — that’s the sync. If anyone has a hard blocker, reply with "blocked: <reason>" so we can escalate.
